title: Circular Cold Saws — Manual & Semi-Automatic Metal Cutting Saws for Tube and Bar | NovoTech Canada
meta_description: İşitan SFC circular cold saws in Canada: 10-3/4″, 12-1/2″ and 13-3/4″ blade metal cutting saws with manual, pneumatic or semi-automatic vise, round to Ø4-1/2″, mitre 45° both ways, two speeds, wet cutting. Specs in inches, CSA panels, parts in Mississauga, ON.
intro: Wet-type circular cold saws for burr-free cuts in tube, bar and profile: the SFC 275 and 315 pull-down saws with a manual or pneumatic vise and the semi-automatic SFC 350-VX with a hydro-pneumatic head for short batch runs. Two blade speeds, mitre cuts 45° left and right, a double split vise that grips both sides of the cut and a low-voltage trigger in the handle — the metal chop saw that leaves a square, cool, weld-ready end instead of an abrasive burr. HSS blades with TiN, TiCN and TiAlN coatings for mild, high-strength and stainless steel, CSA-approved panels and support from Mississauga, ON. For automatic production cold saws see our Bekamak range.

faq.q: Cold saw or abrasive chop saw?
faq.a: An abrasive chop saw grinds through the steel at high speed, leaving a hot, burred, slightly bevelled end and sparks. A cold saw cuts with a slow HSS blade (45–90 rpm) under coolant, so the cut is square, cool to the touch, burr-free and ready to weld or fit — and the blade is resharpened dozens of times instead of thrown away.

The SFC V clamps with a hand vise — the simplest saw for occasional cuts. The SFC VP clamps with air at the pull of a lever, which saves time on every cut and holds short pieces better. The SFC 350-VX runs a semi-automatic cycle from a foot switch with a regulated head descent, for batches of the same part without an operator on the handle.

A standard HSS blade cuts mild steel and aluminum. For medium-hard steel we fit TiN-coated blades, TiCN for high-strength steel and TiAlN for stainless. The blade bore is 32 mm with two Ø11 mm pin holes on all SFC models, so blades are readily available in Canada.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
